x: EDDIE KULUKUNDIS Who's Who devotes over 40 lines to Eddie and at first glance you would be forgiven for believing that his predominant hobby was the theatre.

Our Patron, Eddie Kulukundis, and Susan Hampshire delighted us with their presence and amongst the Club's official guests were Rachel and Steve Ovett, the latter rounding off the speeches appropriately with typical Ovett humour.
Club patron, Mr Eddie Kulukundis, agreed with a wonderful gesture, to double the amount. Star of the day was Gary Staines who was the only person throughout the country to dip under 4 minutes.

Our commisserations are extended to our Patron, Eddie Kulukundis, who lost his cousin Minos in the Lochabie air disaster. The occasion was particularly tragic as Eddie and Minos were travelling by separate flights to the USA to attend the funeral of another cousin.

Our congratulations go out to our Patron, EDDIE KULUKUNDIS, on his OBE in the New Year Honours List. The award, for his services as Chairman of the Sports Aid Foundation and to Athletics, was highly deserved.

Before bringing these comments to a close it would be ungracious not to bring to the members notice the "behind the scenes" activities of our Patron, Eddy Kulukundis O.B.E. who not only made some financial arrangements for us, but also certain facilities such as accommodation.
